title: UE's usage setting
text: The UE's usage setting defined in 3GPPTS24.301[15] applies to voice capable UEs in 5GS and indicates whether the UE has preference for voice services over data services or vice-versa, where
a) voice services include IMS voice; and
b) data services include any kind of user data transfer without a voice media component
